eventsPublished.description: Emitted when an execution plan transitions from pending → running.
Emitted when an execution plan is paused by an operator.
Emitted when a paused plan resumes.
Emitted when a plan is cancelled (terminal).
Emitted when all nodes in a plan complete successfully.
Emitted when one or more nodes fail beyond retry budget with no failover.
Emitted when a node's dependencies are met and it is eligible for dispatch.
Emitted when a node's job is claimed by a worker.
Emitted when a node's job completes successfully.
Emitted when a node fails (after retries/failover exhausted).
Emitted when a milestone's completion condition is satisfied.

integrationOrder: Call setDefinitionResolver(dbBackedFn) to swap in-memory store for DB
Wire EventBusPort adapter to real aiEventBusService.publishSafe/publish
Wire QueuePort adapter to real queueManagerService.enqueue/cancelJob
Wire WorkerPort adapter to real workerClusterService.getCapabilities
Wire DispatcherPort adapter to real jobDispatcherService.getStatus
Register OpenAPI fragment paths in root openapi.yaml

knownRisks.description: WorkflowDefinitions and ExecutionPlans are stored in-memory (Map). All data is lost on server restart until Team 24 runs the migration and wires the DB adapter.
knownRisks.mitigation: Run migration draft + call setDefinitionResolver() before production use.

knownRisks.description: QueuePort, EventBusPort, DispatcherPort, and WorkerPort are interfaces only. The engine does not auto-dispatch jobs or publish events until Team 24 provides adapter implementations.
knownRisks.mitigation: NullPort stubs are provided for testing. Wire adapters during integration.

knownRisks.risk: No authentication on node transition endpoints
knownRisks.description: Node-level PATCH endpoints (running/completed/skipped/ready) should be callable only by trusted workers, not arbitrary API clients. Currently protected by the same adminAuth as other endpoints.
knownRisks.mitigation: Team 24 should add worker-token validation on node transition routes.

knownRisks.description: When multiple branches have equal estimated duration, all are marked critical (zero slack). This is correct CPM behaviour but may produce wider critical paths than expected.
knownRisks.mitigation: Accepted behaviour. Operators should set distinct estimatedDurationMs values.
